title: net1 v6 added data: wider delays, buffers and capacities, and 120 s episodes
description: net1 v5 is honest only inside its training ranges (one-way delay 5 to 60 ms, buffers 0.25 to 8 BDP, base capacity 4 to 150 Mbit/s, 30 s and 60 s episodes). This adds data that widens every range (5 to 150 ms, 0.25 to 32 BDP, 1 to 200 Mbit/s) with the same broad conditions and controllers, in 30 s and 120 s episodes: on a large BDP one Reno recovery takes minutes and a Cubic epoch about 10 s, so 30 s episodes rarely show a competitor's whole cycle, and the 120 s ones hold many capacity steps and arrivals and departures late in the episode. Two held-out sets lie beyond the new ranges: one-way delay 151 to 250 ms, and buffers of 32 to 64 BDP (the 16,000-packet cap clips a third of those). examples/net1_broad.py, sets wide30, wide120, ood-rtt-wide, ood-buffer-wide; every 6th step kept, as for net1 v4 and v5. A planned cross flow whose handshake does not complete before its stop (its SYN keeps meeting a full deep buffer) sends nothing and is recorded as never connected (cross_connected_ms null); the episode stays valid. An episode that fails validation is recorded as failed, left out of the data (net1 reads only ok episodes) and counted in summary.md; it does not stop its shard.
prepare: for s in wide30 wide120 ood-rtt-wide ood-buffer-wide; do uv run python examples/net1_broad.py "$OUT/spec-$s" --set $s --models "$IN/models"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$s/campaign.json" "$OUT/campaign-$s"; done
run: for s in wide30 wide120 ood-rtt-wide ood-buffer-wide; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$OUT/campaign-$s" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps --steps-stride 6 || echo "$s: an episode failed; it is recorded as failed and left out of the data"; done
collect: echo '| set | status |' > "$OUT/summary.md"; echo '|---|---|' >> "$OUT/summary.md"; for s in wide30 wide120 ood-rtt-wide ood-buffer-wide; do uv run expliccit campaign status "$OUT/campaign-$s" > "$OUT/status-$s.json"; echo "| $s | $(jq -c . "$OUT/status-$s.json") |" >> "$OUT/summary.md"; done
